Game Overview

Flappy Bird is a arcade game built around guide your bird through a maze of pipes by tapping to stay aloft. Precision and patience are key in this addictive arcade challenge. With its deceptively simple controls, every successful obstacle maneuver boosts your score. Test your reflexes and persistence in this endlessly engaging game that demands perfect timing!

How to Play

Playing Flappy Bird comes down to a simple loop. Guide your bird through a maze of pipes by tapping to stay aloft! Precision and patience are key in this addictive arcade challenge. With its deceptively simple controls, every successful obstacle maneuver boosts your score. Test your reflexes and persistence in this endlessly engaging game that demands perfect timing!
